exposure: Presence of a notch in uterine arteries
Bilateral vs. unilateral uterine artery notching
High resistance index (RI) and pulsatility index (PI) in uterine arteries
finding: Patients with bilateral high RI and PI or with the presence of a notch in uterine arteries showed a significantly higher prevalence of adverse pregnancy outcomes including SGA, IUGR, low Apgar scores, and high cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: Patients with bilateral uterine notching had a higher c-section rate along with higher prevalence of SGA and IUGR at screening time.
